headline: "The VAT increase makes us less competitive in the region; the measure hits formal business"
summary: The Albanian Tourism Association warns that a VAT increase from 6% proposed in the Fiscal Package would make registered accommodation less competitive. Hotels compete with short-term rental apartments.
why: Tax changes in tourism alter cost structures for hotels and push demand between formal accommodation and informal short-term rentals.
